lines.text: A fifth server joined the cache.
Why did almost every session move?
The server is the hash remainder by N, and when N changes, almost every key moves.
Out of a hundred thousand sessions, eighty percent changed servers.
In Amazon's Dynamo, the ring finds the server clockwise, and the new one takes only its arc.
With a hundred points per server, only about twenty percent moved, all to the new one.
With one point per server the load is lopsided, and a hundred virtual points even it out.
How many virtual points per server would you use?
